definitions.gloss: miso-pickled food, food preserved in miso paste
definitions.explanation: Vegetables, fish, or meat that have been pickled or marinated in miso paste, both as a preservation method and for flavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味噌漬|みそづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{味噌漬|みそづ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{香|こう}ばしい→香ばしい：06660_koubashii⟧。
examples.english: Miso-pickled fish smells wonderful when grilled.

examples.japanese: ⟦おばあちゃん→おばあちゃん：10968_obaachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味噌漬|みそづ}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{漬|つ}け{込|こ}んである→漬け込む：09007_tsukekomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧。
examples.english: Grandma's miso pickles have a deep flavor because they've been pickling for many days.

notes:
A traditional Japanese preservation and cooking method where food is packed in miso paste. The miso both flavors and preserves the food. Common items include vegetables (⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧), fish (⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧), and tofu.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {味噌漬|みそづ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧: miso-pickled vegetables
- {味噌漬|みそづ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pickle in miso
- {西京|さいきょう}{味噌漬|みそづ}け: Saikyo miso marinade (sweet white miso, popular for fish)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{塩漬|しおづ}け→塩漬け：09008_shiozuke⟧: salt-pickled (preserved in salt)
- ⟦{粕漬|かすづ}け→粕漬け：08230_kasuzuke⟧: sake lees pickle (preserved in sake lees)
- ⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧: pickles (general term for Japanese pickled foods)
